dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, another soft drink? That's your third today!
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, əˈnʌðər ˈsɔːft ˈdrɪŋk? ðæts jʊr ˈθɜːrd təˈdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know. What will happen if I drink three a day?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. ˈwʌt wɪl ˈhæpən ɪf aɪ ˈdrɪŋk ˈθriː ə ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They have a lot of sugar. If you drink three a day, you'll gain weight.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈhæv ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈʃʊɡər. ɪf juː ˈdrɪŋk ˈθriː ə ˈdeɪ, juːl ˈɡeɪn ˈweɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe. And if you're overweight for a long time, you might get heart disease.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. ənd ɪf jʊr ˌoʊvərˈweɪt fər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm, juː maɪt ˈɡɛt ˈhɑːrt dɪˌziːz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! What will happen if I stop?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈwʌt wɪl ˈhæpən ɪf aɪ ˈstɑːp?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You'll feel better. But why do you drink so many?
dialogue.reading: juːl ˈfiːl ˈbɛtər. bʌt ˈwaɪ duː juː ˈdrɪŋk ˈsoʊ ˈmɛni?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Stress! I have three exams next week.
dialogue.reading: ˈstrɛs! aɪ ˈhæv ˈθriː ɪɡˈzæmz ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then what will you do if you feel tired? Drink more soda?
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈwʌt wɪl juː ˈduː ɪf juː ˈfiːl ˈtaɪərd? ˈdrɪŋk ˈmɔːr ˈsoʊdə?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No! I'll drink water and go to bed early. I promise.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ! aɪl ˈdrɪŋk ˈwɔːtər ənd ˈɡoʊ tə ˈbɛd ˈɜːrli. aɪ ˈprɑːmɪs.
